brand.website.context: Muted second line under the TruckSim GPS wordmark in the PC Telemetry window header; it is the website address and links to it. Copy verbatim.

devices.connected_direct.context: Status next to a device name in the Linked devices list of the PC Telemetry window: the mobile device is connected right now over the local network. Lowercase, short.

devices.connected_relay.context: Status next to a device name in the Linked devices list: the device is connected right now through the Relay Server (over the internet). 'Relay Server' is a product term, capitalize it the same way. Short.

devices.count.context: Counter at the right of the Linked devices card title, {0} = number of mobile devices linked to this PC (0, 1, 2...).

devices.empty.context: Empty state of the Linked devices card when no mobile device has been linked.

devices.last_seen.context: Status next to a device that is not connected right now; {0} is a relative time such as 'just now', '3 days ago', 'yesterday' (keys time.*). Lowercase.

devices.relay_tooltip.text: This device could not reach the PC directly, so its telemetry travels over a secure internet connection through our Relay Server. It works, with a little more delay. {0} shows how to get a direct connection.
devices.relay_tooltip.context: Tooltip on the (i) icon next to 'connected · Relay Server'. {0} is replaced by the link text 'Connection help' (key menu.connection_help) and must start a sentence.

devices.remove.context: Small button on each row of the Linked devices list that unlinks that mobile device from this PC. Keep very short.

devices.title.context: Title of the card listing the mobile devices linked to this PC.

devices.unnamed.context: Fallback name for a linked mobile device that did not report a name.

language.system.context: First entry of the Language submenu: follow the Windows display language instead of a fixed language.

link.cancel.context: Button under the QR code that ends the pairing session and hides the code.

link.code_expired.context: Label shown over the blurred QR code once the 2-minute pairing session has expired.

link.description.text: Open TruckSim GPS on your phone or tablet and tap Scan QR code.
link.description.context: Instruction in the Link a device panel before a QR code is generated. 'Scan QR code' is the button label in the mobile app; keep the <b> tags around its translation.

link.error_cloud.text: Could not reach the TruckSim GPS Cloud Server. Check this PC's internet connection and try again. You can still connect using Manual connection.
link.error_cloud.context: Inline error in the Link a device panel when generating a QR code failed because the PC has no internet. 'Manual connection' is the title of a section in this window (key manual.title); keep the <b> tags.

link.generate.context: Primary button of the Link a device panel: creates a QR code and a 6-character code for pairing a mobile device.

link.generating.context: Label of the same button while the QR code is being created (disabled, with a spinner).

link.no_camera.text: No camera? Enter this code in the app
link.no_camera.context: Small line under the QR code, above the 6-character pairing code, for devices without a camera (emulators).

link.show_new_code.context: Button over the blurred, expired QR code that generates a fresh QR code and pairing code.

link.step1.text: Open TruckSim GPS on your phone or tablet
link.step1.context: Step 1 of 3 shown above the QR code (numbered automatically).

link.step2.context: Step 2 of 3 shown above the QR code. 'Scan QR code' is the button label in the mobile app; keep the <b> tags around its translation.

link.step3.context: Step 3 of 3 shown above the QR code: point the phone camera at this PC screen.

link.title.context: Title of the panel where the user pairs a mobile device with this PC by QR code.

link.try_again.context: Button label replacing 'Generate QR code' after the generation failed.

manual.connection_help_line.context: Line at the bottom of the Manual connection section. {0} is replaced by the link text 'Connection help' (key menu.connection_help).

manual.interface.context: Label of the dropdown in the Manual connection section that picks which network adapter's address is shown.

manual.ip.context: Label of the IP address the user types into the mobile app when connecting by IP.

manual.localhost.context: Entry in the Network interface dropdown for the loopback address 127.0.0.1, used when the app runs in an emulator on this same PC.

manual.reachability.context: Label of the URL the user can open on the phone or tablet to check that it can reach this PC.

manual.reachability_tooltip.text: Open this address in the browser of your phone or tablet. If the page loads, the device can reach this PC.
manual.reachability_tooltip.context: Tooltip on the (i) icon next to the reachability test URL.

manual.title.context: Title of the collapsible section with the network interface, IP address and reachability test for connecting the app by typing the IP.

menu.check_updates.context: Help menu entry that checks GitHub for a newer PC Telemetry version.

menu.close.context: Tray icon menu entry that quits PC Telemetry.

menu.connection_help.context: Link that opens the website page explaining how to connect the app to the PC (menu bar, Manual connection section, relay tooltip).

menu.discord.context: Help menu entry opening the Discord community server.

menu.github.context: Help menu entry opening the source code repository on GitHub.

menu.language.context: Submenu title (under the Server menu) listing the interface languages.

menu.open.context: Tray icon menu entry that shows the window again.

menu.open_log_folder.context: Help menu entry that opens the folder containing the log file in Windows Explorer.

menu.rerun_setup.context: Server menu entry that opens the setup wizard again (firewall rule, game plugin installation).

menu.server.context: Top-level menu title; 'Server' means this PC Telemetry program.

menu.start_with_windows.context: Checkable menu entry (Server menu and tray menu): launch PC Telemetry automatically at Windows login.

plugin.copy_failed.context: Error dialog when installing the plugin fails; {0} = ETS2 or ATS, {1} = the error message.

plugin.copy_invalid_path.text: Cannot install the plugin: the {0} path is not configured or is invalid.
plugin.copy_invalid_path.context: Error dialog when Install plugin is clicked but the game folder is missing or wrong; {0} = ETS2 or ATS.

plugin.copy_success.context: Confirmation dialog after installing the plugin; {0} = ETS2 or ATS, {1} and {2} = the two file paths written.

plugin.copy_title.context: Title of the dialogs about installing the game plugin.

plugin.install.context: Small button in the Game plugin card that copies the telemetry plugin DLL into the game folder. Shown only when the plugin is missing.

plugin.install_corrupted.context: Game plugin status when the plugin files shipped with PC Telemetry are missing; the user should reinstall PC Telemetry.

plugin.installed.context: Game plugin status: the telemetry plugin is present in the game folder.

plugin.invalid_path.context: Game plugin status when the configured game folder is not a valid game installation; 'Server > Re-run Setup' names the menu path (keys menu.server, menu.rerun_setup).

plugin.not_configured.context: Game plugin status when the game folder was skipped during setup (game not installed).

plugin.not_installed.context: Game plugin status: the telemetry plugin is missing from the game folder.

plugin.title.context: Title of the card showing, for ETS2 and ATS, whether the telemetry plugin is installed in the game folder.

server.not_running.context: Red server status pill when the local HTTP server could not start; {0} = the error message from Windows.

server.port_in_use.text: Not running · port {0} is in use
server.port_in_use.context: Red server status pill when another program already uses the TCP port; {0} = the port number (31377).

server.retry.context: Small button next to the red server status pill that tries to start the local server again.

server.running_game.context: Green server status pill: telemetry is flowing from the simulator; {0} = the game name (Euro Truck Simulator 2 or American Truck Simulator).

server.running_starting.context: Teal server status pill: the game process is running but the plugin is not sending data yet; {0} = the game name.

server.running_test.context: Teal server status pill in developer mode: the server serves a test telemetry file instead of the game.

server.title.context: Title of the small card holding the server status pill.

server.waiting.context: Amber server status pill: the server runs but no game (ETS2/ATS) process is running.

setup.done_installed.text:
The server has been installed.
Press OK to start the server.
setup.done_installed.context: Dialog after the setup steps all succeeded.

setup.done_installed_errors.text:
The server has been installed with errors.
Press OK to start the server.
setup.done_installed_errors.context: Dialog after setup when at least one step failed (the error was already shown).

setup.done_title.context: Title of the dialogs shown when setup or uninstall finished.

setup.done_uninstalled.text:
The server has been uninstalled.
Press OK to exit.

setup.done_uninstalled_errors.text:
The server has been uninstalled with errors.
Press OK to exit.
setup.done_uninstalled_errors.context: Dialog after an uninstall where at least one step failed.

setup.elevation_required.text:
Administrator rights are needed to configure the firewall and the URL ACL.
Please run the server as Administrator.
setup.elevation_required.context: Error dialog when the setup wizard could not restart itself with administrator rights.

setup.error_title.context: Title of an error dialog raised during setup.

setup.game_running.text:
The ETS2/ATS game must not be running during setup.
Please exit the game and try again.
setup.game_running.context: Warning dialog when Re-run Setup is chosen while the game is running.

setup.help.context: Link in the setup wizard opening the GitHub project page.

setup.install.context: Main button of the setup wizard that runs all setup steps.

setup.network_error_title.context: Title of the error dialog shown when the network interfaces could not be listed at startup.

setup.nothing_to_uninstall.text: The server is not installed, nothing to uninstall.
setup.nothing_to_uninstall.context: Dialog when the uninstaller runs but no setup step is installed.

setup.process_error_title.context: Title of the error dialog shown when detecting the game process failed.

setup.status_group.context: Group box title in the setup wizard listing the four setup steps with a status icon each.

setup.step_acl_install.context: Setup step: register the HTTP URL reservation (URL ACL) in Windows; {0} = the URL like http://+:31377/. Keep 'ACL' as-is.

setup.step_acl_uninstall.context: Setup step in uninstall mode; {0} = the URL.

setup.step_firewall_install.context: Setup step: create the Windows Firewall rule; {0} = port number (31377).

setup.step_firewall_uninstall.context: Setup step in uninstall mode; {0} = port number.

setup.step_plugin_install.context: Setup step: copy the telemetry plugin file into the game folders.

setup.step_plugin_uninstall.context: Setup step in uninstall mode: remove the telemetry plugin file from the game folders.

setup.step_vcredist.context: Setup step: the Microsoft runtime package; product name, keep as-is.

setup.title.context: Title of the setup wizard window shown on first run and from Server > Re-run Setup; the version number is appended. 'TruckSim GPS Telemetry Server' is the full product name of this program.

setup.uninstall.context: Main button of the setup wizard in uninstall mode.

time.hours_ago.context: Relative time in hours, {0} is 1 to 23; use the short hour unit of the language.

time.just_now.context: Relative time for less than a minute ago.

time.minutes_ago.context: Relative time in minutes, {0} is 1 to 59; use the short minute unit of the language.

time.yesterday.context: Relative time for one day ago; lowercase, follows 'last seen'.

tray.background.text: Running in the background. Double-click to open.
tray.background.context: Windows notification balloon when PC Telemetry starts minimized to the tray.

tray.restore.context: Windows notification balloon the first time the window is minimized to the tray.

tray.title.context: Title of the tray notification balloons and the tray icon hover text.

update.download_failed.text: Could not download the update. Please check your internet connection and try again.
update.download_failed.context: Error dialog when downloading the new installer failed.

update.downloading.text: Downloading update... This may take a moment.
update.downloading.context: Label in the progress dialog while the installer downloads.

update.downloading_title.context: Title of the download progress dialog.

update.failed_title.context: Title of the dialogs about a failed update.

update.later.context: Button in the update dialog that postpones the update.

update.latest.text: You are running the latest version (v{0}).
update.latest.context: Dialog after a manual update check when no newer version exists; {0} = installed version like 2.0.0.

update.launch_failed.text:
The update was verified but could not be launched:

{0}
update.launch_failed.context: Error dialog when the downloaded installer could not be started; {0} = error message.

update.no_release_notes.context: Shown in the update dialog's release notes pane when the GitHub release has no description.

update.now.context: Button in the update dialog that downloads and installs the update.

update.open_failed.text: The downloaded update could not be opened. Please try again.
update.open_failed.context: Error dialog when the downloaded installer file could not be read.

update.rejected.text:
The downloaded update could not be verified and was rejected.

Please report this to support. Your current version will keep working.
update.rejected.context: Error dialog when the installer's digital signature or version check failed.

update.release_notes.context: Label above the release notes text in the update dialog.

update.title.context: Title of the dialog offering a newer PC Telemetry version.

update.unreachable.text: Could not reach the update server. Please try again later.
update.unreachable.context: Error dialog after a manual update check when GitHub could not be contacted.

update.view_on_github.text: View the full release on GitHub
update.view_on_github.context: Link in the update dialog opening the release page.

window.title.context: Window title bar text; the version number is appended after it. 'PC Telemetry' is the short product name of this program.
